EPISODE NUMBER: Episode 2
EPISODE LOGLINE: The will names Maya as heiress; Victoria strikes back and Eleanor reveals a secret about Maya's mother.
CONTINUITY NOTES: Picks up immediately from Episode 1 as Mr. Cross faces Maya.
